## My slides and blogs

1. Slightly dated slides from the class **Practical R** that I developed and taught for several years at the National Institutes of Health. They cover data munging and visualization in R. The slides are here: <https://www.araastat.com/BIOF339/slides/index.html>
    - The slides on Data Structures and the Week 2 material will be particularly useful for you.

> Rmarkdown sources of all the lectures are available. These will be very similar to what the Quarto version would be today.
